short_bio: Placement Manager | Gamer | Anime Enthusiast | Story-Driven Explorer | Building careers by profession and exploring worlds through stories by passion.
website_bio: Hi, I'm Prashant — a Placement Manager, gamer, anime enthusiast, and storyteller at heart. Professionally, I work in talent acquisition, placements, employer partnerships, and candidate success. Over the past few years, I've helped students and professionals connect with opportunities across technology, data, product, and business roles. Beyond work, I'm passionate about story-driven video games, anime, web series, and immersive worlds. Whether it's exploring the journey of Arthur Morgan in Red Dead Redemption 2, experiencing the philosophy of Vinland Saga, or diving into the mysteries of Dark Fantasy and Psychological Thrillers, I enjoy stories that leave a lasting impact. I'm also the creator behind Mad World Gaming, a personal passion project focused on gaming, entertainment, characters, stories, and pop culture. My goal is simple: build meaningful relationships, keep learning, and create a space where career growth, gaming, anime, and storytelling come together.
interests: Gaming, Anime, Storytelling, Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, Career Growth, Technology, Pop Culture
franchises: God of War, Red Dead Redemption, Assassin's Creed, Resident Evil, Naruto, One Piece, Attack on Titan, Vinland Saga
